comment: ICF acronym — The glossary explains SNOMED CT and GPS but gives no comparable explanation of ICD-11. Readers need the modern architecture of ICD-11 before interpreting later lists. Evidence: WHO ICD overview (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases), WHO clinical documentation hub (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/clinician-documentation-hub), ICD API data model (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/APIDoc-Version2/).
